extractions.extraction_text: Today we have some on the slido too. Okay. So, it's 9 o'clock. Good morning everyone. We are going to have our first real class for today. And here is the QR code for every session. Um, I will have a corresponding QR code for this session. If you have some question, leave your question on slido.

extractions.extraction_text: Or if you have some question in the end, we will also have one minute reflection in the end.

attributes.effectiveness_note: Provides a dedicated time for students to reflect on the material at the end of the session.

extractions.extraction_text: If you are belong to those school, Chaoyang University of Technology, Tatung University, National United University, Taipei Medical University, National Open University, National Sun Yat-sen University, Providence University, Shih Chien University, Feng Chia University, National Kaohsiung University of Science and Technology. extractions.extraction_text: For those student, you did not see your school's name on it, which means you directly take the course with it. We actually will give you the grade and then all the question will come to us.

attributes.objective_description: Understand the single course structure on NTU Cool for students whose schools are not listed as satellites.

extractions.extraction_text: pay attention to your NTU Cool account.

extractions.extraction_text: NTU Cool send you the invitation email to the email you left in our school system. And then you need to go to your email to click the link and accept the invitation and do login.

extractions.extraction_text: If you are just pending, just like the student right here, and then you will find out that then right here, login ID, SID is totally empty. So our TA do not have the chances to contact you.

attributes.topic_covered: Consequences of not activating NTU Cool account
attributes.effectiveness_note: Illustrates the negative outcome (TA cannot contact) of not completing the activation.

extractions.extraction_text: But they do having some extra selection student, we do not have your information. So please remember to check your mailbox in your school system and try to activate it. It is very important.

attributes.topic_covered: Importance of account activation for certain students
attributes.effectiveness_note: Emphasizes the critical need for activation due to missing information for some students.

extractions.extraction_text: Because later on, you need to participate to a lot of in-class quiz with us.

So how much point you receive, it did not affect your final score. The only thing is in the end, we will see what is the percentage you are going for our quiz. So if you bad, you don't need to write email to TA, say I did some mistake, I'm sorry, can you turn that again? No, it does not affect your score. If you just participate, it will be fine.

attributes.effectiveness_note: Reduces student anxiety about quiz performance by explaining that individual scores do not affect the final grade, only participation matters.
